name: track_functions
description: Enables collection of function-level execution statistics, including call counts and time spent per function.
symptoms: Inability to identify expensive user-defined functions
Misattribution of query cost due to untracked function overhead
tuning_tips: Enable 'pl' for basic procedural-language function profiling; use 'all' only when diagnosing complex function-heavy workloads, as it incurs measurable overhead. Disable ('none') in production unless actively troubleshooting function performance.
